env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

logos build -o $WORK/good$GOEXE ./good
! logos build -o $WORK/bad$GOEXE ./bad
stderr -count=2 'correctness::result_before_error_check'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/ef

go 1.27

-- lib/lib.lgo --
package lib

type C struct{}

func Fetch() (int, error) {
	return 1, nil
}

func (C) Get() (int, error) {
	return 2, nil
}

-- bad/main.lgo --
package main

import "example.com/ef/lib"

func main() {
	n, err := lib.Fetch()
	println(n, err)
	var c lib.C
	m, err2 := c.Get()
	println(m, err2)
}

-- good/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"strconv"

	"example.com/ef/lib"
)

func main() {
	n, err := lib.Fetch()
	if err != nil {
		return
	}
	var c lib.C
	m, err2 := c.Get()
	if err2 != nil {
		return
	}
	k, err3 := strconv.Atoi("7")
	println(n, m, k, err3)
}
